answerResults.answer: Legal deforestation of 20% of the property (APD), where land use conversion is allowed by law, i.e., forest suppression for pasture (livestock), is considered the most plausible baseline scenario.

evidence.quote: The most likely scenario observed for the Marcondes project area is the conversion of land use and land cover from forest to livestock areas, legally (APD). Legal deforestation of 20% of the property (Scenario 2) is considered the most plausible baseline scenario because the land is expected to be converted to non-forest land and the conversion is legally authorized and documented, following VM0007 v1.8.

answerResults.answer: Exploratory visit, formal presentation, benefit-sharing negotiation, follow-up meetings, and the 6 May 2025 FPIC Principal Assembly were conducted with community participation.

evidence.quote: Phase 2 — On-Site Field Engagement and Validation Field visits and community engagement for the Marcondes REDD+ project have been conducted as follows: 1. November/December 2022 — Exploratory visit: First visit by the project team to the Comunidade São Tomé do Mocambo do Arari. Initial presentation of the REDD+ concept to community leaders, identification of community structure and representatives, and preliminary assessment of community interest and needs. 2. February 2023 — Formal presentation: Formal presentation of the Marcondes REDD+ project to the community association (Associação comunitária local). Detailed explanation of the REDD+ mechanism, voluntary carbon market, VCU generation process, and the role of VCS v4.4/CCB v3.0 certification standards. 3. April 2023 — Benefit-sharing negotiation: Presentation and negotiation of the Benefit-Sharing Plan (Plano de Repartição de Benefícios — PRB). Discussion of benefit categories: direct
